
{{alias}}( tokens )
    Formats an array of reference tokens into a JSON Pointer string.

    Per RFC 6901, an empty array returns an empty string (refers to the root of
    the document).

    Escape sequences are encoded: `~` is escaped to `~0` before `/` is escaped
    to `~1`.

    Parameters
    ----------
    tokens: Array<string>
        Array of reference tokens.

    Returns
    -------
    pointer: string
        JSON Pointer string.

    Examples
    --------
    > var ptr = {{alias}}( [ 'foo', 'bar' ] )
    '/foo/bar'
    > ptr = {{alias}}( [ 'a/b', 'c~d' ] )
    '/a~1b/c~0d'
    > ptr = {{alias}}( [] )
    ''

    See Also
    --------
